findings.evidence: Lines 110–113 use `hA`, `hFc`, and `hFf` solely to construct `hxmem` and `hymem`; the remainder of the proof depends only on those membership facts, reciprocity, `hFB`, and `hsub`.
findings.fix: State the core theorem with a forward-cluster-membership hypothesis, then derive the continuous-extension form as a corollary using `mem_clusterSetOn_of_continuousOn_extension`; use that corollary in the conformal theorem.
findings.issue: `injOn_of_clusterSetOn_inverse_subsingleton` assumes `A ⊆ closure U`, `ContinuousOn F (closure U)`, and `EqOn F f U`, although its argument only needs `∀ x ∈ A, F x ∈ clusterSetOn f U x`. This makes the topology-level API less general than the proof and its stated inverse-cluster principle.

summary: The general inverse-cluster injectivity theorem unnecessarily hard-codes one way of establishing forward cluster membership.
